title: DayVerdict
description: Output of scoreDay() for one beach and one local date (beach-day-scoring skill). The verdict is derived from the average score of the best 3-hour window, and the score/verdict bands are enforced below so the two can never disagree.

verdict.description: Key, not display text. Display text and colour token come from the UI: great='Great beach day', good='Good', fair='Fair — pick your hours', skip='Skip it'.

reasons.description: Top reasons, most important first (skill: top 3-4). Plain text, rendered with textContent.

advice.description: Non-scoring advice such as UV ('sunscreen, shade 10 am–4 pm').

confidence.description: 'outlook' for days 4 and later (skill). 'forecast' for days 1-3. The name 'forecast' is this contract's choice; the skill only names 'outlook'.

marineAvailable.description: false when wave/water factors were skipped because Marine data was missing; a reason must then say so.
